carrier.present: low32 contain raw i32 two-complement bits; no sign extension into high32
carrier.absence: low32 are zero and tag belongs to declared mask

operations.name: tsfg_nullable.absence
attributes: tag:signless-i32 exact 1 or 2 allowed by result mask

roles.entry: all parameters and return are one of the 13 existing host scalars; first test uses i32
roles.internal: parameters and return are existing scalars or nullable-i32 masks1/2/3
roles.functionTypes: func.call/func.return/cf edges use exact MLIR types; mask changes require retype
roles.ordinaryOperations: existing scalar operand/result rules retained; no nullable operand accepted by old eq/ne/const/arithmetic/bitwise/ordered compare/not
roles.candidateWithoutMarker: reject any candidate operation, type, result, operand or block argument
roles.hostAdmission: reject internal selection and non-scalar full signature before initialization, state mutation or effects

signatureRecord.parameters: ordered array of prefixed type hashes

identity.strings: strict UTF8, no NUL, no normalization; canonical logical paths retain colon and reject dot segments/backslash

proof.definitions: immutable SSA register identity; no stale proof across new definitions
proof.branch: direct tag_test predicate filters exact operand identity on true and false edges
proof.phi: union actual predecessor argument sets after edge filtering
proof.call: result resets to full callee declaration set; no body-specialized inference
proof.copyReturnRetype: preserve complete carrier and proven possible tags
proof.fixedPoint: monotone finite dependency worklist; complete before validating proof uses
proof.empty: never grants get or retype proof
proof.cycles: retain existing entry/loop semantic-fuel and no unmetered-cycle requirements
proof.deadBlocks: reject structurally unreachable blocks; infeasible-edge empty facts never grant proof
proof.capacity: precheck bounds and capacity from verified block/register/instruction counts; at most three inserted tag bits per flow state

verification: complete module metadata, identities, types, roles, dominance, CFG, fuel and tag proof before publishing bytes
canonicalization: stable generic MLIR print; canonical read-print and verified identity optimize preserve operations, anchors and roles
futurePrivateWire: separate exact descriptor/schema and explicit command bound to this Core schema; never TSFGTBC0/wire9 fallback
